description: Append one step to an existing caller-identified causal trial (preregister, formulate, seal, intervention request, outcome, belief revision or replication request). Requires authenticated access, trial_id and idempotency_key. A record is not proof of an intervention or scientific result; seal_prediction requires a nonempty payload. Use the same trial_id for related steps and retain returned hashes/status.

assignment_id.description: Optional assignment identifier from the trial record.

hypothesis_id.description: Optional hypothesis identifier from the trial record.

idempotency_key.description: Required stable idempotency key (8–160 characters) for this step; use a distinct key for a different step.

operation.description: Required trial step from the listed enum; seal_prediction additionally requires a non-empty payload.

payload.description: Optional operation-specific JSON object; for seal_prediction it must contain at least one field.

prediction_id.description: Optional prediction identifier returned by a prior step.

trial_id.description: Required caller-assigned stable trial identifier; reuse for steps belonging to the same trial.

name: run_cassie_causal_trial
title: Register a Cassie causal-trial step
